task.title: M1: Data-driven tree-sitter walker with TS/TSX/JS config (size + complexity)
task.description:
Implement the generic tree-sitter walker that every language's baseline reuses. It loads web-tree-sitter and a per-language .wasm grammar lazily (only when a file of that language is seen), and is driven by a language config object naming function node types, branch node types, and comment node types. From those it computes per-file size (loc, code, blank, comment lines) and per-function cyclomatic complexity with nesting, emitting files[] and functions[] entries plus complexity {sum, max, functions} per file. Files that fail to parse fall back to plain-text line counting. Ship the TS, TSX, and JS configs and grammars, and record languages.ts = 'baseline'.

Acceptance criteria:
- walk(root, config) returns Partial<Snapshot> with files[] and functions[]; the grammar .wasm is loaded once and only when needed.
- Line counts match a hand-counted fixture for a TS file with block and line comments.
- Cyclomatic complexity counts if/else-if/ternary/loops/case/catch/logical operators per the config, with a nesting increment, and matches fixtures for several functions.
- Unparseable or binary files produce a loc-only record and never abort the walk.
- Files under .gitignore, node_modules, and other VCS-ignored paths are skipped via git ls-files.
- Tests cover TS, TSX, and JS fixtures and the plain-text fallback.
